memo.verdict: Neutral; park at SEK 39.74, with a dated re-look after the Q3 2026 report on 2026-10-22; conviction medium on the direction of the business and low on the return. The gate line does not park the case (no D or F on management, business quality, predictability or trackability, all C); the return does. Progress if the price falls below about SEK 37 (the eighteen-month bar on the modal path) with the Q3 thresholds cleared, or if the Q3 print shows adjusted gross margin held above 38 percent with Fiber Solutions organic growth above 5 percent, which would raise the margin condition from plausible to probable and lift the blended return above the bar at today's price. Pass if Fiber Solutions organic growth is below 5 percent or the group margin below 8 percent in Q3 2026, or on a goodwill impairment. The one-line bet: a restructured duct maker's US volumes and margin hold for four more quarters while its data-centre and defence niches grow into half of profit, at a price that already assumes the first and not the second.
case: - Hexatronic over-built for the 2022 fibre-to-the-home boom and under-absorbed its European duct factories through 2024 and 2025 (adjusted EBITA margin 16.6 percent to 8.4 percent; reported EPS SEK 4.18 to SEK -0.07). A chief executive appointed in March 2025 cut SEK 120m of annual cost, re-cut the group into three reported segments with 2028 targets, raised SEK 600m of equity and bought three service and connector businesses at 4.7x to 6.0x EBITDA. Four of the twelve internal forces are strong and none of the screen's red flags is present (external decisive chief executive, transformation delivered, no manufactured guidance rise, no crown jewel sold, leverage 1.7x adjusted, no debt-funded buyback); the empire-building flag is the one to watch with the M&A architect leaving.

- The external forces net to a tailwind: US carriers (private-equity-backed builders) restarting as rates fall, BEAD's USD 42.5 billion flowing from 2026 with early states allocating 80 to 95 percent to fibre, hyperscale and enterprise data-centre demand (global fibre supply shortage 2 percent in 2026 and 14 percent in 2027), defence budgets. Against: European FTTH still falling 10 percent with a market moved from homes passed to homes connected; fibre prices up 50 to 60 percent in twelve to eighteen months with a three-month index lag and no financial hedge; the krona translation drag. The company's own cycle has turned (A): group organic growth -2 percent to +11 percent, Fiber Solutions -11 percent to +11 percent, Fiber Solutions margin 5.2 percent (Q4 2025) to 9.1 percent (Q2 2026).

- 'Financial Outputs' turned up in Q2 2026 for one quarter: organic +11 percent, adjusted EBITA +33 percent to SEK 224m at 10.0 percent, sales beat 11 percent, EBITA beat 12 percent, and the sell-side raised (all raises at FY2027 in 2026; FactSet FY2027 mean EPS +15.1 percent over twelve months; Redeye base case SEK 28 to SEK 44). The Fiber Solutions margin rise came with the cost programme completed, so the floor is structurally higher whatever volumes do. Cash conversion (84 percent after 26 percent) and working capital (26 percent of sales) have not followed.
counter_case: Q2 2026 was a restocking quarter dressed as an inflection. US carriers who held record excess stock in 2025 re-ordered as rates fell; the +44 percent is off a depressed base after Fiber Solutions North America fell through 2025; Europe, half of sales at Q1 2026, fell another 10 percent and will not recover before 2028; raw-material costs rose 21 percent in a year (SEK 1,141m to SEK 1,377m) and adjusted gross margin fell 140 basis points to 38.7 percent; the company draws no glass and sits behind Corning and Prysmian in a shortage the supply side says lasts into 2027, and non-integrated cable makers have already failed on guaranteed deliveries; Data Center's 56 percent growth was half acquired, its margin fell five points to 15.5 percent, and the labour-intensive installers being bought dilute the manufacturing margin further; the newly built US duct capacity at Ogden, Utah and Clinton, South Carolina under-absorbs again; the M&A architect who ran acquisitions since 2014 has resigned mid-pivot with the Head of M&A now acting Head of Data Center; there is no dividend, no anchor owner above 10 percent, one named covering broker and USD 8.0m of daily value; and the shares have doubled to a median multiple. On this reading Hexatronic is the risks research's "false friend", group numbers held up by acquisitions and a cyclical bounce while the core decays, and the right multiple is the two-year median of 10x on FY2027 EPS of about SEK 2.00, that is about SEK 20, about -50 percent. The earnings review's own author names restocking the most credible bear case, and the covering broker calls its own forecasts contingent on North America.

The foundations version: a non-integrated assembler squeezed between ten to twelve glass drawers raising prices 50 to 60 percent and hyperscalers buying glass direct and approving Tier-2 suppliers; a "moat" that is an installation system in a fragmented duct market where European prices fall with volume; about 1 percent US share; a cyclical beta on US carrier capex with no claim on the AI profit pool, which belongs to Corning and Prysmian. Larger integrated peers add 40 to 50 percent US fibre capacity for H2 2028; the risks research's failure mode of consolidated peers using scale to undercut is rated high plausibility. The setup version: the best-fitting pattern is a cyclical trough turn the market has already paid for, a late 'Trough on Trough' with no setup left. The case version: crisp but not robust, with no cash return, a wide skew (about SEK 20 to about SEK 67), a multiple that can halve, a small capitalisation, six named concerns, and a dependence on a raw-material pass-through management has guided may lag.
triggers: - Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-22: the sell-side's two thresholds (Fiber Solutions organic growth above 5 percent; group EBITA margin above 8 percent); adjusted gross margin held above 38 percent with Fiber Solutions organic above 5 percent raises the margin condition from plausible to probable and lifts the blended return above the bar at today's price; a miss on either threshold is a pass.
- Price: below about SEK 37 on the modal path (SEK 32.3 on three years; SEK 39.6 and SEK 34.5 on the blend) the case clears the bar with the Q3 thresholds cleared.

- Whether US demand is structural or restocking: our side probable structural for eighteen months (about 70 percent); change of mind on Fiber Solutions organic below 5 percent in Q3 or a second quarter of US duct-peer deceleration. Alarm: Fiber Solutions organic below 5 percent; invalidate: negative US organic growth for two quarters.

- Whether the group margin holds through raw-material inflation: plausible (about 60 percent); consensus assumes a rising margin (EBITDA 13.1 percent FY2026 to 14.5 percent FY2028). Alarm: adjusted gross margin below 38 percent for two quarters, or group EBITA margin below 9 percent in a quarter; invalidate: gross margin below 36 percent, or group margin below 8 percent.

- Whether the mix pivot earns a higher multiple: needs Data Center at or above 15 percent growth and margin through FY2027 (about 65 percent) and the group margin holding (about 60 percent); joint about 39 percent, rounded to 35 percent. Change of mind: two more quarters with Data Center and Harsh Environment above half of adjusted EBITA at combined margins above 14 percent. Alarm: below 45 percent of adjusted EBITA in any quarter; Data Center margin below 15 percent; invalidate: Data Center margin below 13 percent for two quarters.

- Whether management can integrate three to six acquisitions a year without its M&A architect: possible only (about 50 percent). Change of mind: a permanent appointment and a fourth deal at the stated multiples by the Q4 2026 report, or a goodwill impairment. Alarm: no permanent Deputy Chief Executive or Head of Data Center by the Q4 2026 report; invalidate: a goodwill impairment or a founder departure at an acquired unit.

judgement.title: APM PMS Q&A SOP: the weekly session for Tuesday 6 October 2026, on Monday 5 October 2026 closes
judgement.heading: Hexatronic | Core Investment | 4.95% of the fund's capital in 4 tranches
judgement.markdown:
- **Industry:** O. Industrials and capital goods. Industry RS 79 at the Friday 2 October reading (66 four weeks earlier)
- **Sector:** O.4. Capital goods, grid. Sector RS 52 at the 30 September month-end (78 four weeks earlier). Its other companies: Arteche (Stock RS 92, held), Cenergy (93, in the Pool), Prysmian (77), NKT (63), Nexans (52), Legrand (49), and 5 more
- **Cohort:** fibre optic communications infrastructure. No cohort reading (1 priced company; a reading needs 3); none other in our universe


**What is going on, and why it matters**

- **The price move by beta:** over 5 sessions the stock rose 11.8%; the market's fall explains -1.1%, so its own move was +12.9%, 1.5 times its usual size (about 8.5%). It rose on 1, 2 and 5 October (+2.6%, +3.3% on about twice its usual volume, +1.6%).
  - No public news explains it: the company's news page has nothing since September, and the move matched the technology bid that lifted Mycronic (+7.3%), ASML (+7.8%) and Oxford Instruments (+5.4%) over the same sessions
- **The sector and cohort:** Hexatronic leads a cooling sector (Sector RS 52 at the month-end from 63 at the end of August and 97 at the end of June) with Stock RS 94
  - It has no cohort reading, so the sector line is the only group reading the rule can use, and it sits two points above the 50 that would meet half of the third criterion
- **The analysts:** Net Upgrade Breadth, sales estimates +20% and target prices 0%, down from +100% on both at the end of August: the upgrade cycle after the second-quarter results has run its course, so this week's rise is price without estimates behind it

**What it means for the position**

- **Holding:** hold; none of the six Sell Criteria is met; Industry RS 79 and Stock RS 94
- **Selling:** the nearest trigger is the relative 52W high trigger at about SEK 37.19, about 13% below Monday's SEK 42.81, read at the 30 October month-end; *possible within the quarter, not the base case*: a full reversal of this week's 12% rise would leave the price about 3% above the trigger.
  - The 30% levels are SEK 31.79 for the first tranche and SEK 29.97 for the other three, 26% and 30% below
- **Adding:** allowed by the rule (1.73% of room; the next add of 1.67% takes the holding to 6.62% and Industrials to 23.97% of capital)
  - Not wanted before the third-quarter report on 22 October, because the price is above the memo's park level (SEK 39.74), the memo's re-look is dated to that report, and the analysts' breadth has gone to zero on target prices
  - A print clearing all three thresholds I put a little better than even, from the memo's own odds of about 70% on US demand and 60% on the margin

**What we could lose:** about 0.65% of the fund's capital, to the relative 52W high trigger (1.43% to the 30% levels)

**Experiment: which stocks Hexatronic's own moves have tracked** (last 3 and 6 months)

- **Mycronic** (same country of listing): 0.66 and 0.51, strong
- **Lagercrantz** (same country of listing): 0.52 and 0.39, moderate
- **Prysmian** (same sector): 0.47 and 0.40, moderate
- **Nexans** (same sector): 0.42 and 0.41, moderate
- **My reading:** look at Mycronic first; Hexatronic trades with the Swedish technology names, and this week's rise was theirs as much as its own

**The Investment Analyst's memo (digest of 22 September at SEK 39.74; memo republished 1 October)**

- **Decided:** neutral; park at SEK 39.74 with a dated re-look after the third-quarter report on 22 October; conviction medium on the business, low on the return. The park is on the return, not on the gate (all four gates C)
- **Must happen:** US duct volumes and margin hold for four more quarters while the data-centre and defence niches grow into half of profit; at the third quarter, Fiber Solutions organic growth above 5%, group EBITA margin above 8%, adjusted gross margin above 38%
- **Main risk:** the second quarter was a restocking quarter dressed as an inflection; raw-material costs up 21% in a year; European fibre-to-the-home still falling 10%
- **Expected return (the Modal return):** below our 20% a year bar at the park price; the case clears the bar only below about SEK 37, and the TSR/Valuation reading is F at Monday's higher price
- **Next test:** the third-quarter report on 22 October (the three thresholds above)

**My judgement:** bullish on the position, medium conviction: one of the strongest technical names in the book (Stock RS 94, Sell-side Momentum A) after a rise this week that it shared with the Swedish technology names rather than earned on news; hold through 22 October and add only on a print that clears the memo's thresholds.

- **Counter-case:** a 13% own move in five sessions on no news, in a Swedish small cap whose analysts have stopped raising, is the kind of move that reverses
  - A miss on the margin threshold on 22 October takes the price back through SEK 37, and the relative 52W high trigger (SEK 37.19) is then live at the 30 October reading

**What would change my view:** the third-quarter report on 22 October (Fiber Solutions organic growth, the 8% group margin, the 38% gross margin); the 30 October reading; a close below SEK 37
